title.narrative: Empowering women in local climate change policy

description.narrative: Rural and indigenous women and young people are particularly vulnerable to climate change due to their dependence on agriculture and gender inequality. The project supports the development of their leadership and negotiation skills in order to increase their participation in political decision-making processes, contributing to the design and implementation of nature-based climate change adaptation measures at the local government level. It also creates spaces for dialogue between communities. Other measures include the restoration of ecosystems, the protection of water sources and the promotion of sustainable agriculture. The project contributes to the implementation of Ecuador's national climate protection goals and strengthens the role of women in climate policy, supported by partnerships with local governments, organisations and academic institutions.
